svg.text: Chrystal Moon Base · 8-Legged Freaks · Scale 1:3.5 · 24 Servos · VACUUM-RATED · PC Space Grade · DS3240/DS3225/DS3218 · Raspberry Pi 5 8GB + 2× Pico W · CC0 2026
PTC 30A: after each 7.4V buck · before servo rail
PTC 15A: after each 6.0V buck · before servo rail
★ Pico W via USB-CDC (no UART conflict with RPLIDAR) · 3.3V GPIO cannot power servos
★ I2C1 pull-up 4.7kΩ to 3.3V on SDA+SCL · ferrite bead 100Ω@100MHz at GPIO header
★ Expected I2C1 devices: 0x28 (BNO055) · 0x29 · 0x2A (VL53L1X) · PCA9685 via Pico
★ Pi5 PCIe port available for future NVMe SSD or AI accelerator (Hailo-8L etc.)
★ Active cooling recommended under servo load · Pi5 throttles at 85°C
USB-CDC → Pi5 · powered FROM Pi5 USB
I2C0: PCA boards have 10kΩ pull-ups onboard.
If I2C errors: add 2.2kΩ on Pico W #1 SDA/SCL
I2C MONITORING BUS · Pico W #2 · I2C1 GP6/GP7
Ch 12: Leg1 GRIPPER · Ch 13: Leg2 GRIPPER · OE: GP13
Ch 12–15: spare · OE: GP13 parallel with PCA-A
NOT from Pico USB — kills Pi5!
I2C0 shared bus · PCA-A (0x40) + PCA-B (0x41) different addresses same 2 wires
B — LEGS 1–4 · PCA9685-A · ADDR 0x40 · CH 0–11 + CH 12–13 (ARM GRIPPERS LEG 1+2)
D — WIRING LEGEND, CRITICAL NOTES & POWER BUDGET
11.1V — Raw LiPo to buck inputs · 18AWG red · high current
7.4V — DS3240 HIP + DS3225 UPPER servo power · 18AWG orange
6.0V — DS3218 LOWER servo power ONLY · 18AWG green · MAX 6.8V!
I2C Bus — SDA/SCL · 22AWG shielded · 4.7kΩ pull-up · ferrite bead · <15cm
PWM Signal — PCA9685 to servo signal pins · 22AWG yellow/white
Junction dot — electrical connection (not just crossing)
GND return: all servo GND → star-point · 18AWG black · NEVER via chassis!
1. PCA9685 V+ pin: UNCONNECTED or tied 100Ω to GND.
Servo power goes DIRECT from buck converters to servos.
Connecting servo power to V+ destroys the chip instantly.
2. DS3218 Vop MAX: 6.8V absolute. Buck target: 6.0V. No flex!
3. GND star-point: ALL grounds at power system block only.
No ground loops. Chassis GND separate from signal GND.
4. E-Stop: relay between battery+ and buck inputs (not on output!).
5. I2C: twisted pair · ferrite 100Ω@100MHz at each PCA · 15cm max.
6. INA226 shunt: most breakout boards = 2mΩ NOT 10mΩ. Measure yours!
At 2mΩ: set current_lsb for 0–10A · else readings are 5× too low.
8. ARM MODE (Leg 1+2): grippers on PCA9685-A Ch12+13 ONLY — PCA9685-B Ch12-15 spare.
Quick-release connector: ≥15A/pin rating required — standard servo JST melts at peak!
9. ARM MODE walking: Legs 1+2 deployed → robot walks on Legs 3–8 (6-pod mode).
10. MODE SWITCH SAFETY: Lock Legs 3–8 tripod stance before deploying arms.
11. ARM LASERS: Class 3R · nooit direct in oog · 33Ω weerstand verplicht op elke lijn.
RED=smelten actief · GREEN=temp OK · beide uit in veilige stand (OE hoog).
Verify INA226 current <5A per leg before arm release. Software fault = fall risk.
DS3240 hip on Legs 3–8 carries full weight — check torque margin at 1:3.5 scale.
Gripper servo Ch12/Ch13 on PCA-A: 50Hz PWM same as leg servos.
Verify polarity with multimeter before every new connector.
Cut-off: 9.0V · Charge each pack separately · Max 1C = 5A
☐ Measure all buck outputs BEFORE connecting servos
☐ Confirm PCA9685 V+ pins unconnected (BOTH boards)
☐ E-Stop: measure 0V on ALL buck outputs within 1s of press
☐ Measure 6.0V buck HOT under 2A load · if >6.5V → STOP immediately
☐ Boot Pi5 · verify GPIO 3.3V · zero servo power
☐ Connect servos one leg at a time · watch INA226
☐ Home all joints before gait routine
☐ ARM MODE: test quick-release pull force ≥20N before first swap operation
☐ ARM MODE: verify tripod stance lock before deploying Leg 1+2 as arms
E — BILL OF MATERIALS (CMB8LF v1 · ONE ROBOT)
2 · Raspberry Pi Pico W · servo ctrl + monitoring
2 · Gripper servo DS3225/MG996R · Ch12+13 · Leg1+2 arm end-effector
2 · Quick-release connector · bajonet/magnetic + mechanical lock · ≥15A/pin · 3-pole min · test ≥20N pull
2 · Modified foot plate · walk mode + docking receiver for peer robot
4 · Laser module 6mm RED 650nm 5mW 3V · GP17+GP19 · amazon.nl B0982CYKYV
8 · Resistor 33Ω · laser current limiting (3.3V Pico → laser module)
1 · NC emergency stop button · mushroom red
26 · DS18B20 sensor · 1-Wire per servo · thermische cutoff 70°C
1 · Aeroglaze Z306 · matte zwart · ε=0.95 · radiatieve koeling
1 · Master Bond EP21TDCHT · vac-rated lijm · -196°C tot +177°C
★ VL53L1X XSHUT: boot low, then high for addr assign
★ FASE 1: Earth demo · 50+ swap cycli · film · funding pitch
★ FASE 2: Vacuum test 10⁻⁵ mbar · zelfde hardware · geen rebuild
★ FASE 3: TRL 5-6 · pitch ESA · DLR · private space

★ GND return: 18AWG black per servo to star-point · NEVER use chassis as GND
★ VACUUM: Prusament PC Space Grade · MoS₂ droog · EP21TDCHT · GAP PADs · Z306

★ Docking protocol: Robot A holds still · Robot B arm-poot grijpt + verwisselt been
